bio: Enjoy a garden-inspired Afternoon Tea at the beautiful Hillsborough Castle and Gardens. This delightful Afternoon Tea features a selection of seasonal savouries and sweet treats.  Explore Northern Ireland's royal residence, where worlds and minds meet. Relax in 100 acres of picturesque gardens, explore the State Rooms still used today and indulge in a delicious Afternoon Tea in the café. Served in the Weston Pavilion, it's the perfect place to relax and catch up with family or friends after a day exploring the historic Hillsborough Castle and Gardens.  Begin your Afternoon Tea with a seasonal soup of the day, before tucking into a delicious assortment of savouries. Fruit scones are served with cream and seasonal garden jam, followed by elegant mini pattisserie. Afternoon Tea is served with unlimited Thompsons Irish tea.  Located in the historic Hillsborough Castle, Hillsborough is just South-East of Belfast.
